rows.title: Stream switching
rows.detail: When the channel you are watching goes offline, StreamNook picks a new live stream and starts it for you.

rows.title: Follow raids
rows.detail: When the streamer raids another channel, StreamNook jumps there with them (you need to be signed in).

rows.title: Stay in chat
rows.detail: When the stream you are watching ends, you stay in the channel's chat instead of being switched away.

rows.title: AV1 & h265
rows.detail: Asks Twitch for AV1 and h265 (HEVC) versions of the stream alongside h264, which some channels offer at better quality for the same bandwidth.

rows.title: Start timeout
rows.detail: How long StreamNook keeps trying to open a stream before giving up, which helps when a channel has only just gone live.

rows.title: Retry delay
rows.detail: How long to wait between attempts while a stream is not available yet (0 means a single attempt).

rows.title: Autoplay
rows.detail: A stream starts playing as soon as it opens, with no need to press play.

rows.title: Start quality
rows.detail: Every stream opens at this quality, and you can change it anytime from the player controls.

rows.title: Start muted
rows.detail: Every stream opens silent until you unmute it.

rows.title: Start volume
rows.detail: The volume every stream opens at before you adjust it.

rows.title: Resume VODs
rows.detail: Reopening a past broadcast picks up where you left off.

rows.title: Device sync
rows.detail: Keeps your place in each VOD the same on every StreamNook you sign in to, and saves it to your Twitch account.

rows.title: Low latency
rows.detail: Rides as close to live as the Twitch site on channels that support it. On by default.

rows.title: Buffer
rows.detail: How much video the player keeps loaded ahead of playback; more is steadier on a shaky connection but adds delay.

rows.title: Listen time
rows.detail: How many seconds of audio to fingerprint; longer matches more reliably over talking or noise, but the result takes a little longer to appear.

rows.title: Retries
rows.detail: If the first listen matches nothing, StreamNook listens again this many times.

rows.title: Target latency
rows.detail: How close to live the player stays: how far behind the live edge it rides; lower is closer to live. Auto picks a gap that suits each channel (reopen the stream to apply).

rows.title: Languages
rows.detail: Streams in Discover and Kick browse. Your device language until you pick some.

rows.title: Layout
rows.detail: Turn the phone sideways and tap the chat button on the player. Chat floats over the video, or takes a column beside it.

rows.title: Keep screen on
rows.detail: The screen stays on while the Chats tab is open, until 30 minutes pass without a touch.

rows.title: Merged feed
rows.detail: When a streamer you are watching also streams elsewhere, their other chats join this one in a single feed, each message marked with where it came from.

rows.title: Feed
rows.detail: Live chat shows everything, while Top chat is YouTube's own filtered view that keeps a very fast chat readable.

rows.title: Currency
rows.detail: Show Super Chat amounts converted to one currency. Rates refresh daily; until they load the amount shows as sent.

rows.title: Polls
rows.detail: A live poll card with the running vote tally.

rows.title: Predictions
rows.detail: A live prediction card with the outcomes and how points are stacking up.

rows.title: Redemptions
rows.detail: A chat row when someone redeems a channel point reward that does not post its own message, like a no-input reward.

rows.title: Gift sub batches
rows.detail: One 'gifting N subs' row with the recipients attached when someone gifts a batch, instead of a row per gift.

rows.title: Clip chat replay
rows.detail: Shows the chat that was live while a clip was recorded, beside the clip.

rows.title: Style
rows.detail: Subs, gifts, bits and milestones as tinted cards, as a plain row with a ring, or as a plain row.

rows.title: Glint
rows.detail: A short highlight when an event row lands: a sheen across it, a pulse, or a spark that runs around the edge.

rows.title: Cheers
rows.detail: Bits cheers as their own card with the cheer gem, or as an ordinary message with the cheermotes inline.

rows.title: Wording
rows.detail: Your own sentence for each kind of event. Tokens in braces fill in from the event; if one is missing, the platform's wording is used.

rows.title: Platforms
rows.detail: Turn event kinds off per platform. Lit means shown.

rows.title: Collapsed
rows.detail: Shows the pinned message as a compact one-line bar when you enter a channel.

rows.title: Dividers
rows.detail: A thin line between messages so a fast chat is easier to scan.

rows.title: Striped rows
rows.detail: Gives every other message a slightly different background, in your theme's colors, so rows are easier to follow.

rows.title: Spacing
rows.detail: Blank space between messages; more room means fewer messages on screen.

rows.title: Text size
rows.detail: Size of message text.

rows.title: Text weight
rows.detail: How heavy the message text is, from light to bold.

rows.title: Message animation
rows.detail: How a new message arrives: a short fade or slide as each one lands. History loaded on join never animates, and it is skipped when motion is reduced.

rows.title: History opacity
rows.detail: Dim the scrollback that loads when you join a chat, so live messages stand out.

rows.title: Timestamps
rows.detail: Shows the time each message was sent, next to the name.

rows.title: Name style
rows.detail: How names stand out from the message: plain, or with a bar, chip, brackets, or dot.

rows.title: Readable colors
rows.detail: Nudges a chatter's color lighter on a dark theme, or darker on a light one, until it stands out from the background. The hue stays theirs. Off shows colors exactly as they set them.

rows.title: Badges
rows.detail: The platform's own badges next to names: moderator, subscriber, VIP and the rest. Custom mod & VIP badges are a channel's own art from FrankerFaceZ.

rows.title: Badge size
rows.detail: How big badges draw, relative to the text.

rows.title: Add-on badges
rows.detail: Badges from 7TV, FFZ, Chatterino, Homies and the other badge services, plus StreamNook membership badges.

rows.title: Profile pictures
rows.detail: 7TV shows the picture someone set on 7TV when they have one; Twitch always shows the platform's own, across the app.

rows.title: Pictures in chat
rows.detail: On platforms that send one (YouTube, TikTok), the chatter's picture leads their message.

rows.title: @ prefix
rows.detail: Writes every name as @name.

rows.title: Paint shadows
rows.detail: Some paints stack several drop shadows for readability; keep them all, just one, or none if names look too noisy.

rows.title: Mention sound
rows.detail: Plays when someone @s you in any chat you have open.

rows.title: @name style
rows.detail: How an @mention reads in chat.

rows.title: Highlight
rows.detail: The color that marks a message mentioning or replying to you.

rows.title: Keep tinted
rows.detail: Hold the mention or reply color behind the whole message for as long as it is on screen, instead of only a flash.

rows.title: Vibration
rows.detail: A short buzz when a message says your name, on top of the highlight.

rows.title: Paint
rows.detail: Draws a mentioned name in that person's 7TV paint instead of a flat color.

rows.title: Thread color
rows.detail: The color that marks replies in a thread.

rows.title: Context
rows.detail: How a reply shows the message it answers: a context line above it, an @name at the start, or nothing.

rows.title: Emoji style
rows.detail: Which set draws the emoji in messages. System uses your device's own.

rows.title: Personal emotes
rows.detail: Emotes from a chatter's own 7TV personal set. Off shows the text they typed instead.

rows.title: Animation
rows.detail: Play animated emotes, or show only their first frame. Never is the lightest on the GPU in a fast chat.

rows.title: GIFs
rows.detail: Twitch lets Tier 2 and Tier 3 subscribers post GIFs. Off swaps each one for a small chip you can tap to reveal.

rows.title: Size
rows.detail: Scales GIFs in chat relative to the text, with 1.00x being the default size.

rows.title: Size
rows.detail: Scales emotes in chat relative to the text, with 1.00x being the default size.

rows.title: Spacing
rows.detail: Space on each side of an emote; go negative to let neighboring emotes overlap.

rows.title: Notices
rows.detail: Shows a chat notice when a mod adds, removes, or renames a 7TV emote in the channel.

rows.title: Effects
rows.detail: Applies FrankerFaceZ modifiers (wide, flips, rainbow, shake) to the emote before them, the way FFZ does.

rows.title: Modifiers
rows.detail: Applies BetterTTV modifiers (w! wide, h! and v! flips, c! cursed, p! party, s! shake) to the emote after them, the way BetterTTV does.

rows.title: Giant emotes
rows.detail: Draws the last emote of a "Gigantify an Emote" power-up message at 4x below the message, like Twitch does.

rows.title: Duplicate sends
rows.detail: Lets you send the same message twice in a row by adding an invisible character, so Twitch does not reject the second send.

rows.title: Spellcheck
rows.detail: Underlines misspelled words as you type and offers corrections when you tap one. Emotes, chatters, commands and links are left alone.

rows.title: Chat modes
rows.detail: Shows when a channel limits who can chat, like emote-only, followers-only or slow mode. The message box names the mode and keeps a small icon for it while you type.

rows.title: Hide placeholder
rows.detail: Leaves the message box empty instead of prompting you to send a message. Notices you can act on, like read-only or subscriber-only mode, still show.

rows.title: Hide emote button
rows.detail: Removes the smiley from inside the message box. The emote picker still opens from the emote suggestions as you type.

rows.title: Inbox button
rows.detail: Which end of the message bar the inbox sits at. Right swaps it with the chat menu, for a right thumb.

rows.title: Wallet balance
rows.detail: Always shows your balance beside the wallet button in the message box. Hidden keeps just the icon, and the wallet shows your balance when you open it.

rows.title: Show gains
rows.detail: A +N shows beside your channel points when you earn some: for every gain, or only for a bonus chest.

rows.title: Emotes
rows.detail: Suggest matching emotes as you type.

rows.title: Chatter names
rows.detail: Also suggest display names of users currently in chat.

rows.title: Bonus chests
rows.detail: Collects the bonus chest on the stream you are watching the moment it appears.

rows.title: Deleted messages
rows.detail: How a message looks once a moderator deletes it or times out or bans its sender.

rows.title: Hide shared chat
rows.detail: Hides messages that came from the other channel in a Twitch Shared Chat, so you only see this channel's own chatters.

rows.title: Smooth resume
rows.detail: Animates the scroll back to the bottom when you tap Resume; auto-scroll for new messages stays instant.

rows.title: Scrollback
rows.detail: How many messages each chat keeps to scroll back through. Phones stop at 300: more than that costs memory and smoothness with nothing extra to see.

rows.title: Menu style
rows.detail: A list that opens from the chat name, or a row of tabs under the chat header so each chat is one tap away.

rows.title: Scrollbar marks
rows.detail: Small ticks on the chat scrollbar show where mentions, subs, announcements and pinned messages are, so you can find what you missed while reading back.

rows.title: Vary repeats
rows.detail: Adds invisible characters to a line that repeats the one before it, so Twitch doesn't drop it as a duplicate.

rows.title: Speed
rows.detail: One line every <delay>. Add --delay <ms> to a command to change it for one run.

rows.title: Style
rows.detail: Off keeps links as plain text, Card + Link adds a preview card under the link, and Clean shows only the card.

rows.title: Short links
rows.detail: Shows each link as a compact label, the site plus a short path, instead of the full raw URL.

rows.title: Color
rows.detail: The color of links in chat. Leave it on the default to follow the theme.

rows.title: Underline
rows.detail: Off leaves links colored but not underlined.

rows.title: Known bots
rows.detail: Hides StreamElements, Nightbot, Moobot and the other well-known chat bots, in every channel.

rows.title: Everywhere
rows.detail: Messages from these names never appear, on any platform. Add someone here, or from their user card in chat.

rows.title: Per channel
rows.detail: Added from user cards while watching. Removing a name shows their messages again in that channel.

rows.title: Bot commands
rows.detail: Hides messages that are bot commands, so a chat full of !drops and !uptime reads as a chat.

rows.title: Ignored phrases
rows.detail: Never see messages that contain these words, in any chat. The sender is not told. Plain words work; turn on regex or whole-word per phrase when you need precision.

rows.title: Disk cache
rows.detail: Loads emotes and badges from disk: a copy is stored on this iPhone after the first download so later channel loads are near instant. Off means every launch fetches them again.

rows.title: Refresh after
rows.detail: Anything older than this is fetched again the next time it is needed, so new emotes and badge art show up on their own.

rows.title: Storage
rows.detail: View cache info shows a count of what is on disk, and Clear cache deletes every stored emote and badge so they download fresh.

rows.title: Followed channels
rows.detail: Scan your follows to see how many emotes are missing and how much space they need, then download them in the background while you do something else.

rows.title: Detailed log
rows.detail: Records connection, playback, and chat activity to streamnook.log on this device so a problem can be traced after the fact.

rows.title: Log export
rows.detail: Shares your logs as one zip, so you can save it to Files or send it straight to an app for a bug report.

rows.title: Channels and emotes
rows.detail: Counts which channels you watch and which emotes you use, which is what fills in your profile stats and unlocks accolades.

rows.title: Version and platform
rows.detail: Records which build you are on, your operating system, and whether update checks are getting through.

rows.title: Linked accounts
rows.detail: Records which other platforms you have connected, so they survive a reinstall.

rows.title: VOD positions
rows.detail: With Device sync on, keeps where you left off in each VOD you open, so your place follows you to your other devices.

rows.title: Ad-free playback
rows.detail: Routes the playlist through a public relay and removes ad segments before the player sees them.

rows.title: Relays
rows.detail: Your own relay addresses, one per line.

rows.title: Theme
rows.detail: The color theme for the whole app.

rows.title: Glassiness
rows.detail: How see-through and frosted every surface is, for every theme.

rows.title: Font
rows.detail: The interface font.

rows.title: OLED accent
rows.detail: The glow color on pure black.

rows.title: Notifications
rows.detail: StreamNook can alert you about the categories below.

rows.title: Live channels
rows.detail: When a channel you follow goes live

rows.title: Which channels
rows.detail: Everything you follow, or all but the channels you muted

rows.title: Mentions and replies
rows.detail: When someone mentions or replies to you

rows.title: Drops
rows.detail: Campaign progress and claimable rewards

rows.title: New badges
rows.detail: When a new global badge becomes available

rows.title: Counts as a mention
rows.detail: Your @name always counts. These count too, in Mentions and for notifications.

rows.title: Name without @
rows.detail: Your login written without the @ counts as a mention.

rows.title: Display name
rows.detail: Your display name counts as a mention when it differs from your login.

rows.title: Highlight words
rows.detail: A message matching one of your highlight words notifies you and collects in Mentions.

rows.title: Muted chats
rows.detail: Mentions in these chats never notify you or reach the Mentions list.

rows.title: Mentions while you're away
rows.detail: StreamNook's server watches chat in channels you follow for your name and replies, and keeps matches for 7 days.

rows.title: Instant alerts
rows.detail: Pushed the moment a channel goes live.

rows.title: How often to check
rows.detail: Checking less often uses less battery.

rows.title: First-time chatters
rows.detail: Highlight a user's first ever message in this channel.

rows.title: Returning chatters
rows.detail: Highlight users coming back after a long absence.

rows.title: Your own messages
rows.detail: Tint your own outgoing messages so they are easy to spot in fast chats.

rows.title: Raid announcements
rows.detail: Highlight the raid notice row when a raid lands.

rows.title: Custom sounds
rows.detail: Your own audio files, up to 2 MB each.

rows.title: Highlight phrases
rows.detail: Flash chat messages that match specific words, names, or patterns.

rows.title: Username highlights
rows.detail: Always highlight messages from specific users by login.

rows.title: Badge highlights
rows.detail: Highlight every message from users carrying a specific Twitch badge.

rows.title: Custom commands
rows.detail: Define your own slash commands.

rows.title: Reminders
rows.detail: Post a message into a chat on a timer or a keyword.

rows.title: Swipe to moderate
rows.detail: Swipe right on a message in a channel you moderate to delete it, time its sender out or ban them. Pull further for a longer timeout.

rows.title: Steps
rows.detail: What the swipe offers, mildest first: delete, the timeout lengths, then ban.

rows.title: Hold menu buttons
rows.detail: Delete, Timeout and Ban in the press-and-hold menu.

rows.title: Timeout lengths
rows.detail: The four timeout lengths on a user card in channels you moderate, the same four wherever a quick timeout is offered.

rows.title: Card buttons
rows.detail: Your own buttons on a user card in channels you moderate: a timeout, ban, unban or warning with a saved reason.

rows.title: Nicknames
rows.detail: Nicknames you've set for individual chatters.
